ITA-1.9.4.4 rajaḥ रजः
Agitation, activity
Characterized by activity, initiation, action and attachment, it is capable of vitiating the mind.

.3 rajatam रजतम्
Silver
Ag (Argentum). Duly processed rajata is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-5.17.1 rājayakṣmā राजयक्ष्मा
Consumption disorder complex, diminution of structural components

rājasarogaḥ राजसरोगः
Diseases caused by agitative, reactive tendency
A disorder of the psyche caused by an increase in agitative, reactive tendency in the individual, e.g. excessive anger, jealousy or impetuousness.

ITA-2.8.19 rājasikakāyaḥ राजसिककायः
Person with agitated, reactive temperament
The mental and physical characteristics of the person with an agitated, reactive temperament are violence, cowardice, jealousy and greed.

.4 rājāvartaḥ राजावर्तः
Lapis lazuli
Duly processed rajavarta is employed as a stand-alone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbomineral pharmaceutical formulations.
